description: Four units whose lossless common header states segments of 1 sample (log2 0), and the DTS:X word after the band data, which is not looked for.

crosscheck.decode_error: Too few samples per XLL segment

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder refuses a segment of no samples before the DTS:X word (dca_xll.c: 'Too few samples per XLL segment')
